tomato.summary_ja: 8月には岐阜県などで40℃超の猛暑によりトマトなど夏野菜の収穫が減り[4]、9月には長雨と日照不足で入荷が減って野菜の価格が上がったと報じられています[2][3]。ただし10月初めにはトマトは平年より1割ほど安いとも伝えられています[1]。
tomato.summary_en: Reports point to heat above 40°C in August, in places such as Gifu, that cut summer vegetable harvests including tomatoes [4], then prolonged rain and low sunshine in September that reduced arrivals and pushed vegetable prices up [2][3]. By early October, though, tomatoes were reported about 10% below their usual level [1].

apple.summary_ja: 見出しと記事は、2025年産リンゴが猛暑や雪害などで不作となり、2026年8月までの販売期間を通じて高値だったと伝えています[1][4]。9月の値下がりそのものの理由は書かれていません。
apple.summary_en: The headlines and article describe the 2025 apple crop, which was small after summer heat and snow damage and sold at high prices through August 2026 [1][4]. They don't explain the September drop itself.

potato.summary_en: Reports say good summer weather in Hokkaido, the main growing area, kept the harvest on track, making potatoes cheaper than usual and good value in September [2]. An August outlook also expected stable supply to keep prices low [3].

cabbage.summary_ja: 記事はいずれも10月のもので、名古屋では9月の大雨で上がった価格が天候の安定で下がり[2]、札幌でも関東や北海道の収穫回復で平年並みに戻ったと報じられています[1]。沖縄では長雨や台風で高値と伝えられ[4]、9月の値下がりの理由は分かりません。
cabbage.summary_en: These reports are all from October: in Nagoya, prices pushed up by heavy September rain fell as the weather settled [2], and in Sapporo they returned to normal as harvests in Kanto and Hokkaido recovered [1]. Okinawa reported high prices after long rains and typhoons [4]. They don't explain the September drop.

greentea.summary_ja: 海外での抹茶需要の高まりで国産茶葉の価格が上がり、農家の高齢化などで国内生産も減っていると報じられています[2][3]。茶葉の値上がりを理由に、緑茶飲料の値上げも伝えられています[1][4]。
greentea.summary_en: Reports point to growing overseas demand for matcha pushing up domestic tea leaf prices, while domestic production shrinks as farmers age [2][3]. Price rises for green tea drinks, blamed on costlier tea leaves, have also been reported [1][4].

rice.summary_ja: 民間在庫が過去最多となり新米の販売も鈍いなど供給過剰で、コメの小売価格は11週連続で下がり、前年より大きく安くなっていると報じられています[1][2][3]。家庭での購入量の減少も伝えられています[1]。
rice.summary_en: Reports say oversupply, with record private inventories and slow sales of the new crop, has pushed rice retail prices down for 11 straight weeks, well below a year earlier [1][2][3]. Lower household purchases have also been reported [1].
